Olivia Park: Quick thread to lock final owners for the metering postmortem follow-ups. Need owners + ETA for: patch, backfill, invoice tags/corrections, credit policy, and recurrence scan. Short replies please.

Marc Liu: I can take the patch. Root cause was ingest consumer retry loop from transient DB timeouts. Plan: add capped retries + DLQ + jitter. Canary tomorrow AM, full rollout Thu noon PT.

SRE Team: We'll monitor canary and stand by during rollout. Add `eng-sre` pager if p95 ingest latency spikes.

Olivia Park: Backfill owner? Need dry-run output, CSV format: account_id, invoice_id, orig_tokens, new_tokens, delta_usd.

Marc Liu: I'll run the backfill tool. Will do a staging dry-run tonight on 20 accounts and produce CSV. Production window Fri 23:00-03:00 UTC.

CS Ops: Finance wants tagging convention: add memo "metering-correction TKT-4210" and a line item "metering adjustment". Auto-credit rules?

Olivia Park: Proposal: auto-credit when corrected delta > $100; enterprise tier auto-100%. Otherwise queue to CS for review. Priya will confirm but we need to move fast.

Finance Bot: Ticket created MET-2025-04-07-TKT-4210; backfill window scheduled Fri 23:00-03:00 UTC. Linked PR 631.

Marc Liu: Dry-run completed. Sending CSV to CS Ops now. Sample reconciliation passes. Ready for prod window.

CS Ops: Received CSV. Will prepare customer emails and apply tagging after backfill completes. Template draft posted to docs; will update with exact wording post-backfill.

Olivia Park: Recurrence scan: Marc, can you run a 30-day query for similar backlog spikes and paste a short summary?

Marc Liu: Running now. Early look: two transient spikes in last 30 days, lower magnitude. Will post plot + table by EOD. If pattern holds, recommend DB write rate-limits and additional consumer batching.

Olivia Park: Owners/ETAs summary:
- Patch + rollout: Marc  canary tomorrow AM, full rollout Thu noon PT
- Backfill exec + dry-run: Marc  dry-run done, prod Fri 23:00 UTC
- Invoice tags & credits policy: CS Ops + Finance  draft policy ready, will apply after backfill
- Alerts & runbooks: SRE Team  monitoring in place
- 30-day recurrence scan: Marc  chart by EOD

Olivia Park: If anything slips, flag here. Will mark postmortem actions as assigned once the backfill and invoice corrections complete. :white_check_mark:
